name.zh: Williamsonia 本内苏铁类种子球果器官

description.en: Use a compact receptacle with a coarse tessellated surface; avoid treating it as an angiosperm daisy.
description.zh: 用紧凑承托体及粗镶嵌表面建形，不将其当作被子植物雏菊。

sources.title: Anatomically preserved Williamsonia: evidence for Bennettitalean reproduction
sources.supports: Williamsonia bockii ovulate cone with densely packed scales and terminal ovules.
sources.access_origin: inherited inventory research; not reopened by this planner
sources.rights_note: Consultation is not a license to redistribute source media.

reconstruction_notes.en: Fossil-specimen organ only: compact ovoid receptacle, restrained polygonal interseminal surface mosaic and short attached stalk. Original conservative three-dimensional thickness, beige fossil palette and nominal 0.1 m height; no whole parent plant, leaf whorl, daisy-like petals, inferred stamens, trunk-embedded structure or modern conifer scales. The mosaic expresses basic surface organization without claiming exact ovules, cellular anatomy or a specimen replica.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 仅化石保存器官：紧凑卵形承托体、克制的多边形间种鳞片镶嵌表面及短柄。保守三维厚度、米褐化石色与0.1米名义高度为原创美术设定；不添加整株、叶轮、雏菊状花瓣、推断雄蕊、干体嵌生结构或现代针叶树球果鳞片。镶嵌仅表达基本表面组织，不主张精确胚珠、细胞结构或标本复制。

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
scientific_scope.zh: 通过独立审查的原创静态风格化启发教学美术；配色、姿态、名义尺寸及简化解剖属于美术选择，不作严格科学复原或同域共存主张。
